annotations.title: Read one area of life from every chart layer

description: Calculates, in one answer, every layer of a birth chart that a question about one area of life rests on: career, money, marriage or relationship, children, property and home, education, spiritual path, the chart as a whole, or timing. It returns the birth chart with each planet's degree, nakshatra, dignity, retrogression and combustion; the area's houses with their lords, occupants and aspects; Ashtakavarga, Shadbala and Vimshopaka strength; the natural and Jaimini karakas; the Navamsa, the area's own divisional chart and each planet's Shashtiamsha (D60) portion; Bhava Chalit; the twelve Arudha padas including the Darapada (A7) and the Upapada; every special lagna; the yogas and doshas with their status; the four running dasha levels with dates and the periods ahead; and today's transits from the Lagna and the Moon. Use it when someone asks a real question about their life, such as how their career or marriage looks, when something may happen, or what their chart says overall. Needs the birth date, time and place.

area.description: The area of life the question is about. Use general for a question about the chart as a whole, and timing for a question that is mainly about when.

birth_date.description: Date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 1990-01-15 for 15 January 1990. People write dates in different orders: day first in India and most countries, month first in the United States. Convert what the person wrote to YYYY-MM-DD yourself. If an all-number date could be read two ways, such as 05-06-1990, ask which number is the day before calling; never assume.

birth_place.description: City and country of birth, for example "Mumbai, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth at the birth place, 24-hour HH:MM, for example 10:30, or 16:26 for 4:26 PM. If the person gave an hour from 1 to 12 without AM or PM, ask which before calling. Ask the user if the time is unknown; do not guess it.

latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of the birth place in decimal degrees, north positive. Give it only together with longitude, when the user supplied coordinates or the place could not be found by name.

longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of the birth place in decimal degrees, east positive. Give it only together with latitude.
